row.body: The clinic key is attached to a note saying one patient did not become ill; the return sheet lists the helper as absent.
row.title: The helper was not on the list

cites.quote: Jolene didn't get sick. She can help.

sidecar.gloss: A clinic note and an absent helper leave a care handoff incomplete.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field trial might record an unaffected worker and a clinic visit; the absent helper does not show a failed evacuation.

row.body: three pickup dots mark the animal-feed sack and hand radio. two were scratched away without wear around them.
row.title: missing count beside the animal-feed sack

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
